meta.game: 明日香ヴァージンアイドルデビュー (Asuka Virgin Idol Debut) v2.260
meta.source: Hand-built from WolfDawn extraction (batch.json speakers, CDataBase character sheet, SysDatabase place names, dialogue sampling).
meta.note: Name order is surname-first (Kagami Asuka) and honorifics are kept. Gender field drives pronoun resolution. Never overwrite by automation.

明日香.role: Protagonist. First-year idol student (Year 1, Sakura Class) at Angel Star Academy; the 'virgin idol' of the title. Full name Kagami Asuka.
明日香.register: Genki, earnest, casual feminine (だよ/うん/〜ね). Flustered and innocent about anything lewd early on; bolder in corrupted routes.
明日香.note: 4,668 dialogue lines. Her AV stage name かぐや is a SEPARATE entry - do NOT merge name boxes.

かぐや.role: Asuka's AV-actress stage name, used on porn shoots and adult TV segments. Same person as Asuka, but the game deliberately switches the name box.
かぐや.register: Bubbly, elongated ero-service voice (～/♡, いや～ん♡).
かぐや.note: Do NOT merge with 明日香 - keep Kaguya wherever the JP says かぐや.

桃花.role: Asuka's classmate and best friend, fellow idol candidate. Stage name 桃花, real name 鈴木桃香 (Suzuki Momoka) - every spelling is the same girl.
桃花.register: Friendly, casual, upbeat (〜だってさ/〜じゃない/よろしく！).
桃花.note: 1,541 lines. Also appears as ？？？ before her introduction scene.

マリア.role: Reigning top idol at the academy; elegant onee-san senpai. Secretly supernatural - her light burns youma.
マリア.register: Refined, confident feminine (〜かしら/〜わよ/〜わね). Never crude.

グローリア.role: Year 3, Yuri Class. The academy's star senior idol; stage name means 'glory'. Real name 木崎未来 (Kizaki Miku) - that form has its own entry, do not swap one for the other.
グローリア.register: Ultra-refined keigo, ojou-sama (ごきげんよう/〜と思います/ご一緒).

木崎 未来.role: Gloria's real name, used in formal/civilian contexts (roll calls, reveals). Same person as グローリア but keep the real name where JP uses it.
木崎 未来.note: Reading confirmed female idol; render surname-first as Kizaki Miku.

クリス.role: Foreign idol candidate from the Norris family, a vampire-hunter lineage; connected to the Holy Knight Chris legend. Full name Christie (クリスティ, own entry).
クリス.register: Polite, slightly formal and knightly (私/父上/です・ます).
クリス.note: Trust dialogue over the boyish nickname - she is female.

クリスティ.role: Chris's full name, used at dramatic reveals (the President recognizes her as クリスティ). Same person as クリス.
クリスティ.note: Keep Christie where JP says クリスティ, Chris where it says クリス.

カノン.role: Street-live (busking) idol; real name 虹咲奏 (Nijisaki Kanon). Her father appears as カノンの父.
カノン.register: Gentle and polite (です・ます + ね), soft giggles (ふふふ).

莉奈.register: Casual, energetic (あ、明日香ー！こっちー！).

美琴.role: Actress who co-stars with Asuka in drama work; introduces her to sugar dating.

ミクル.role: Veteran ex-idol acquaintance, now in the AV industry; recognizes Asuka as 'Kaguya'.
ミクル.note: Distinct from 木崎未来 (Miku) - do NOT merge.

乃亜.role: Famous composer, pen name NOA (studio.NOA); wrote 'Shiny Days'. Also appears unnamed as 子供の父親 (Child's Father) before his reveal.
乃亜.note: Name box 子供の父親 translates literally as Child's Father.

社長.role: Sleazy president of the Super-Lewd Pervert Agency; gateway to the AV route. DB parameter label ドスケベ変態社長 is the same man.
社長.register: Vulgar, rough masculine (うるせえ/〜しな/仕方ねえ). Blunt about sex and money.

学園長.role: Head of Angel Star Academy. Warm but shrewd; sends Asuka to auditions and NOA.
学園長.register: Soft feminine (〜なの/〜ね/励んでね) under formal speech. Trust dialogue over the gender-neutral title.

裏戸.role: Homeroom teacher and professional stage director; androgynous looks, popular with students. Runs stage-battle lessons.
裏戸.register: Formal lecturing polite (です・ます, 〜するように), a little condescending.

志木.role: Sinister man who turns out to be a youma; burned by Maria's light.

長谷・園三郎.role: Veteran kayoukai (pop-music world) singer; comic relief obsessed with ochazuke.
長谷・園三郎.register: Grandiose old-master speech (〜かね/ふっ/若いな).
長谷・園三郎.note: Name box uses an interpunct: 長谷・園三郎.

ヴォーゼングレム.role: Theatrical youma villain in the supernatural arc.
ヴォーゼングレム.register: Mock-polite theatrical (です・ます with a drawled ねェ).

ダークマター総帥.role: Boss of the villain organization Dark Matter.

なでしこTV社長.role: President of the Nadeshiko TV station; one of the gallery's remembered partners.

司会.role: Event/ceremony host at academy and TV events.

監督.note: Keep distinct from ディレクター (TV Director).

子供の父親.role: Pre-reveal name box for Noa when met as a father in town.
子供の父親.note: Same person as 乃亜/Noa; keep the literal descriptor as shown.

竿役男子.role: Male porn performer on AV shoots (竿役 = the 'rod role').

原住民.role: 'Native islander' characters in the AV deserted-island film settings.

ハンター.role: Battle/animation unit in the supernatural arc.

男.note: 男A → Man A, 男B → Man B.

悪漢.role: Beach thug leader who harasses the girls.

先生.role: Generic academy teacher name box (not Urato).

父.role: Asuka's father, seen at events in her hometown arc.
父.note: Distinct from カノンの父 (Kanon's Father).

？？？.role: Pre-reveal name box (used for several characters before introduction, often Momoka early on).
？？？.register: Match whoever is actually speaking in context.

魚善.role: Fishmonger in the shopping street; shop name doubles as his name box.

肉坊.role: Butcher shop in the shopping street.

珍々堂.role: Shopping-street shop; the name is a dick pun (chinchin) - keep it romanized.

伊藤ミート.role: Meat shop; also a remembered-partner label.

鶴の湯.role: Public bathhouse; name box for its keeper.

ひまわり整骨院.role: Osteopathic clinic; name box for its practitioner (massage scenes).
